newsitem.title: DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF CONGO: Meningitis kills 16 people in Kabila's Congo.
newsitem.headline: Meningitis kills 16 people in Kabila's Congo.

text.p: Meningitis has killed at least 16 people in two towns of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the World Health Organisation said on Thursday.
WHO doctor Florimont Tshiogo told Reuters that the epidemics in Kindu and in Kamina had been brought under control.

"The epidemic erupted in Kindu nine days ago, 21 cases have been reported and the death toll is nine," Tshiogo said. "As for Kamina, seven died out of 25 cases," he said, adding that the disease surfaced there in March.
Kindu is in the central Maniema province and Kamina in the southern province of Shaba.

Health standards have dramatically fallen in the nation of over 40 million people since the 1970s. An outbreak of Ebola virus, which causes often terminal bleeding, killed more than 230 people in and around the town of Kikwit in 1995.
